# 1 # Extension Must Be Active: V
# Many important RISC-V extensions are currently active.
# Test Case Name: ADD
# Test Case Type: INSTRUCTION
# Test Case Rule: RULE 1: In the RV64I ISA, the ADD instruction MUST add its two source registers as 64-bit integers and write the 64-bit sum to the destination register.
##### ASSEMBLY #####
li t0, 0x5
li t1, 0xa
add t2, t0, t1
# Result: t2 = 15

# 2 # Extension Must Be Active: NONE
# Many important RISC-V extensions are currently active.
# Test Case Name: ADD
# Test Case Type: INSTRUCTION
# Test Case Rule: RULE 2: In the RV64I ISA, 32-bit integer addition is performed by the ADDW instruction, and the ADD instruction MUST NOT perform a 32-bit addition.
##### ASSEMBLY #####
li t0, -1
andi t0, t0, 0xffffffff
li t1, 0x100000001
add t2, t0, t1
# Result: t2 = 0x200000000

# 5 # Extension Must Be Active: NONE
# Many important RISC-V extensions are currently active.

# Result: gp = 0x8000000000000000

# 6 # Extension Must Be Active: NONE
# Many important RISC-V extensions are currently active.
# Test Case Name: ADD
# Test Case Type: INSTRUCTION
# Test Case Rule: RULE 6: If an ADD instruction produces a result that exceeds the XLEN‑bit representable range (i.e., signed or unsigned overflow occurs), then the processor does not raise an exception: mcause is unchanged and the destination register receives the low XLEN bits of the mathematically correct sum (wrap‑around).

# Result: t2 = 0

# 7 # Extension Must Be Active: NONE
# Many important RISC-V extensions are currently active.

# Test Case Rule: RULE 2: VLE32.V must write each 32-bit element that is successfully read into the corresponding element of the destination vector register group vd for which the element's mask bit in vm is 1.
##### ASSEMBLY #####
li t5, 0x80001000 # mask data address
li t0, 0x1
sb t0, 0(t5) # mask byte 0 = 1 (load first element)
li t0, 0x0
sb t0, 1(t5) # mask byte 1 = 0 (skip second element)
vsetvli zero, x0, e8, m1, ta, ma
vle8.v v0, (t5) # load mask into v0 (mask agnostic)
li t6, 0x80002000 # destination init address
li t0, 0xaaaaaaaa
sw t0, 0(t6) # initial value for element 0
li t0, 0xbbbbbbbb
sw t0, 4(t6) # initial value for element 1
vsetvli zero, x0, e32, m1, ta, ma
vle32.v v2, (t6) # load initial values into v2 (mask agnostic)
li a7, 0x80003000 # source data address
li t0, 0x11111111
sw t0, 0(a7) # source element 0
li t0, 0x22222222
sw t0, 4(a7) # source element 1
vsetvli zero, x0, e32, m1, ta, mu
vle32.v v2, (a7) # masked load: element0 loaded, element1 unchanged
li s0, 0x80004000 # result storage address
vsetvli zero, x0, e32, m1, ta, ma
vse32.v v2, (s0) # store result vector to memory (mask agnostic)
lw a0, 0(s0) # load first result element into a0
# Result: a0 = 0x11111111

# 3011 # Extension Must Be Active: V

# Test Case Name: VLE32.V
# Test Case Type: INSTRUCTION
# Test Case Rule: RULE 3: VLE32.V must leave the destination element unchanged for any element whose mask bit in vm is 0.
##### ASSEMBLY #####

li t0, 0x80001000

vmv.v.x v3, t6

vmv.x.s a0, v3 # move element 0 of v3 to a0
# Result: a0 = 0x11111111
